text: While this title is good it is the same as the title given in the task and changing it up could have made it more creative.
Really good introduction, very nice to read and  makes the reader understand the relevance of the topic by referencing largely-known AI Tools .
I wish you included a short definition of AR in here as you use the term a lot and some users might confuse it with VR

Really good choice of topics. The first contrasts hologphraic AI to conventionally known AI. The second topic higlights the difference in holographic versus other AR AI and the third focuses on the improvments that can be made with holographic AI. This selection allows the reader to first start the paper with something they are familiar with (Google Home/Alexa) to then go deeper in the topic as they understand the topic further.

While I appreciate the emphasis of making the gap in research understood and therefore emphasis the need in this paper, it comes of as repeating the same point over and over given your previous mention in the research gap. Try to either remove the previous mentions in previous paragraphs.
Good points show that you are aware of possible issues. Alltough this party could have been a bit more extensive
Really well researched and very precise with where you see a gap in the research data.
